execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "mock_transactions" (
  "accepted_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "approval_code" TEXT,
  "currency" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "effect_count" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "final_outcome" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "host_reference" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "invoice" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "payment_method_ref" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "provider_account" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "request_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "tran_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("provider_account", "tran_id")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

execute.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER mock_transactions_validate BEFORE INSERT ON mock_transactions
            WHEN NEW.provider_account NOT IN ('mock-account-a', 'mock-account-b')
              OR typeof(NEW.amount_minor) <> 'integer' OR NEW.amount_minor NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 9999999999
              OR NEW.currency <> 'XCD' OR NEW.final_outcome NOT IN ('Approved', 'Declined', 'Incomplete')
              OR NEW.effect_count <> CASE WHEN NEW.final_outcome = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
              OR length(NEW.tran_id) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16 OR NEW.tran_id GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9]*'
              OR length(NEW.invoice) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16 OR NEW.invoice GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9]*'
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Invalid synthetic ledger facts'); END

CREATE TRIGGER mock_transactions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON mock_transactions
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Mock ledger facts are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER mock_transactions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON mock_transactions
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Mock ledger facts are immutable'); END
